basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old software developer from Seattle, Washington, who recently discovered the world of Reddit. My interests range from following the latest trends in cryptocurrency to exploring niche anime genres. I love spending my weekends hiking in the Pacific Northwest and tinkering with my Toyota Tacoma. My online hours are typically in the evenings after work. Currently, I'm single and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies like pilates. I also have a keen interest in health topics, especially related to thyroid issues.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for the past three years. My knowledge of anime is mostly self-taught through online communities and recommendations from friends. Additionally, I have a growing interest in health and wellness topics due to personal experiences.
